name: renkflow-monorepo
description: RenkFlow Monorepo - Web, Mobile & Dashboard Applications

scripts.vercel-build: cd apps/web && npm run build && cd ../.. && rm -rf .next public && cp -R apps/web/.next .next && cp -R apps/web/public public && node vercel-postbuild.cjs
scripts.clean: find . -name 'node_modules' -type d -prune -exec rm -rf '{}' + && find . -name '.next' -type d -prune -exec rm -rf '{}' +
